profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
I attended Furman University in South Carolina where I pursued elementary education. I've always had a natural talent for working with children. During my time at Furman, I took a class on teaching technology to children and discovered that I excel at both children and technology. I used child-friendly resources to teach them how to design websites and create their own Youtube videos. This experience sparked a new career path for me.

After college, I still had a travel bug, so I signed a contract to work for both American and Norwegian cruise lines. These experiences allowed me to travel and taught me the importance of hard work. Working on a cruise means no breaks, no days off, and sometimes no full night of sleep. But it taught me the value of teamwork and supporting my coworkers.

When I started my software development Bootcamp at NJIT, I used the hard work and discipline I learned from working on a cruise to learn to code. The Bootcamp was comprehensive and covered everything from the front end, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, to the back end with Express, React, and SQL. We even covered advanced topics like Python, cybersecurity, and TypeScript.

I recently furthered my career at Dev10 where I have developed two full-stack Java applications. I've built great relationships with my coworkers and managers, and I've learned more than I could have ever imagined.

I love development and believe I can be a great asset to any company as an entry-level software engineer. While I may not know everything yet, I promise to study and work on improving myself every day. I'm eager to learn and be a good employee.

If you need an entry-level software developer, please reach out to me. I look forward to talking to you soon!

positions.title: Java Software Developer
positions.description:
Chosen for a highly selective paid program where only 5% of applicant are hired.

Developed two full stack applications, Jawnathan and Harvest Fetch, using Java and Springboot.

Applied the SDLC methodology to design, develop, and test applications successfully.

Utilized JUnit to test all APIs to ensure code robustness and required functionality.

positions.title: Nanny
positions.description: Provided full-time care and ensured the safety of four boys ranging in age from 1 to 9 years old. Developed strong multi-tasking skills to manage various responsibilities simultaneously.

positions.title: Head Server
positions.description: Maintained a positive attitude while working long hours, resulting in two promotions during my 8-month contract and being recognized as Employee of the Month
